cards.mood: The piece opens with a suspended, ethereal atmosphere that establishes a mood of quiet longing and introspection.
cards.palette: A deep, sustained sub-bass synth provides the harmonic anchor and low-frequency weight, present continuously from the first beat of the rhythm section through to the outro.

lyrics_set.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Verse]
Watching the shadows stretch long
Tracing the lines of a fading day
The city breathes in gray
Mist settles on the window pane
[Pre-Chorus]
A quiet hum in the air
Finding peace in the empty space
[Chorus]
Lost in the soft blue light
Tracing the paths we haven't walked
Falling like leaves on silent ground
Searching for home in the still
[Verse]
Streetlights glow like distant stars
Coffee turns cold in a heavy cup
Time slows down its steady pace
Every heartbeat is a secret kept
[Pre-Chorus]
Whispers of what might remain
Echoes of things left unsaid
[Chorus]
Lost in the soft blue light
Tracing the paths we haven't walked
Falling like leaves on silent ground
Searching for home in the still
[Instrumental]
[Bridge]
The moon hangs heavy and low
Wait for the morning to unfold
[Chorus]
Lost in the soft blue light
Tracing the paths we haven't walked
Falling like leaves on silent ground
Searching for home in the still
[Outro]
